svg.title: NervROS: how a mission runs
svg.desc: An animated sequence diagram with six lanes: You, Agent, Models, Guard, Mission executor and Robot. You ask "Bring the mug to the tray." The agent plans with the robot's skills, the mission executor checks the behaviour tree, you approve four steps, the executor runs them (walk, pick, walk, place), reports progress, and the agent tells you it is done after a camera check agrees. Below the lanes, three paths that work at any time: the agent's tools read the robot (cameras, world model, ROS graph), live robot data feeds the 3D viewer, and Stop goes from you through the Guard to the mission executor with no model in between. A footer lists the tools, model providers, ROS 2 link and robot profile, and what the robot holds.

g.text: Rust. Compiles the plan to a behaviour tree.
Bring the mug to the tray.
tools read: cameras, world model, ROS graph
3D viewer feed: map, robot pose, objects, plan path
